pages.title: Hero of the Illage
pages.text: An $(l:raidborn:utility_and_items/essences)Overlord Essence$() grants Hero of the Illage, the last of the three alliance effects. Illagers stop treating you as prey, and it does not wear off on its own.

pages.title: Alliance Rules
pages.text: It carries 15 recruitment slots by default and strips Bad Omen outright. Unlike the two below it, it survives you attacking or killing an Illager-side creature, so nothing you do in a fight can cost you the pact.

pages.title: Village Relations
pages.text: Any Raidborn alliance effect costs you the village side of the game: Villagers will not deal with you, Iron Golems treat you as hostile, and Hero of the Village stays out of reach while it lasts.
